question: The Union Minister of the Government of India, Rajiv Ranjan Singh, launched the Organic Fisheries Cluster in the ______ district of Sikkim in January 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Soreng**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Union Minister **Rajiv Ranjan Singh** launched the **Organic Fisheries Cluster** in the **Soreng district** of Sikkim in **January 2025**.
 
• **Soreng** is one of the newly created districts of Sikkim, formed in **2021**, known for its scenic beauty and focus on sustainable development initiatives.
 
• The **Organic Fisheries Cluster** is aimed at boosting sustainable aquaculture practices in the region, aligning with Sikkim’s status as a **100% organic state**.
 
• Sikkim, recognized as the first **organic state** in India, has been actively promoting organic farming and sustainable practices across various sectors, including fisheries.
 
• The initiative is expected to promote **self-reliance** among local farmers and fishery workers, enhancing livelihoods and contributing to the region's economy.
